title: Filler Note 121: Urban Sketching Notes
content: Quick urban sketch observations: prefer warm light for facades, loose gesture lines for figures, and a 0.3mm pen for architectural details. Carry a small palette and a travel stool for sessions longer than 30 minutes.

title: Filler Note 122: Travel Packing Checklist
content: Lightweight packing: compressible layers, a compact first-aid kit, charger bank, and photocopies of documents in a sealed plastic sleeve. Plan outfits by activity rather than by day.

title: Filler Note 123: Sourdough Starter Log
content: Starter maintenance: fed 1:1:1 rye/water/flour on day 7, aroma tangy, activity strong after 6 hours at 24Â°C. Next feed: 12 hours before baking, increase ratio to 1:2:2 for rise.

title: Filler Note 124: Keyboard Layout Preferences
content: Three-finger chord practice improved typing speed; mapped CapsLock to Control for shortcuts; prefer split ergonomic layout for long coding sessions.

title: Filler Note 125: Local Hikes
content: Short hikes under 5km with varied elevation: Ridgeview Loop is best in spring for wildflowers; bring layered clothing and insect repellent.

title: Filler Note 126: Plant Watering Log
content: Succulents: watered every 3 weeks in winter, 2 weeks in summer; use well-draining mix. Tropicals: check top 2cm moisture weekly and mist leaves.

title: Filler Note 127: Tea Tasting Notes
content: Green tea: light vegetal aroma, slight astringency when brewed at 80Â°C for 2 minutes. Black tea: full body, notes of malt and dried fruit at 95Â°C for 4 minutes.

title: Filler Note 128: Resume Keywords
content: Highlight outcomes: 'reduced latency', 'led migration', 'improved conversion' â€” use measurable results and role-specific technologies in the top third of the resume.

title: Filler Note 129: Interview Prep Questions
content: Prepare STAR-format answers for leadership examples, two system-design sketches, and one deep-dive on algorithmic optimization tied to past work.

title: Filler Note 130: Home Network Setup
content: Mesh network notes: place primary node centrally, enable WPA3 where available, reserve 192.168.50.1-50 for static devices, and schedule weekly reboots for the gateway.

title: Filler Note 131: Sleep Tracker Summary
content: Average sleep: 7h15m over last 14 days; deep-sleep increased after 30 minutes of evening reading; recommend consistent bedtime within +/- 30 minutes.

title: Filler Note 132: Meditation Practices
content: Daily 10-minute breath-awareness sessions improved focus; alternate with 20-minute guided compassion sessions twice weekly for balance.

title: Filler Note 133: Weekly Reflection
content: Wins: shipped a small feature; Challenges: flaky test suite. Next week: add acceptance test and schedule pair debugging session.

title: Filler Note 134: Recipe - Lemon Tart
content: Pastry: blind-bake at 180Â°C for 15 minutes. Filling: whisk eggs, sugar, lemon zest; bake at 160Â°C until slight wobble; chill before serving.

title: Filler Note 135: Budget Tracker
content: Monthly budget notes: set aside 10% for savings, 5% for subscriptions to review quarterly, and track discretionary spend weekly for trend detection.

title: Filler Note 136: Conference Notes
content: Key talks: 'Scaling with observability' emphasized lightweight instrumentation and automated alert tuning; collect links to slides and speaker contacts.

title: Filler Note 137: Accessibility Checklist
content: Checklist: provide alt text for images, ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text, add keyboard focus states and ARIA labels for interactive components.

title: Filler Note 138: Photography Shot List
content: Golden hour portraits: backlight slightly, reflector fill at 30% power; try both 50mm and 85mm lenses, bracket exposures by 1 stop.

title: Filler Note 139: Debugging War Stories
content: Root cause: caching layer invalidation race; fix involved adding idempotent retries and a short mutex around cache writes to avoid duplicate writes.

title: Filler Note 140: Learning Roadmap
content: Learning plan: complete an advanced algorithms course, build two medium-scale projects, and contribute a bugfix to an open-source library within 3 months.

title: Filler Note 141: Python Library Survey
content: Evaluating Python libraries for data processing. NumPy is solid for numerical work, Pandas excels at tabular data, but sometimes raw SQL with psycopg2 is cleaner than ORMs.

title: Filler Note 142: Linux Distro Comparison
content: Fedora is cutting edge but sometimes breaks stability. Ubuntu is commercial but reliable. Alpine is tiny. Each has tradeoffs depending on use case.

title: Filler Note 143: Note Taking Systems
content: Tried Roam Research, LogSeq, Obsidian, and custom solutions. Each has different strengths. The best system is the one you actually use consistently.

title: Filler Note 144: JavaScript Frameworks
content: Vue is elegant and has lower cognitive overhead than React. Angular is enterprise-heavy. Preact is lightweight. SvelteKit is newer but gaining traction quickly.

title: Filler Note 145: Code Review Practices
content: Good reviews should focus on logic and maintainability, not style (use linters for that). Ask questions instead of making demands. Praise good patterns when you see them.

title: Filler Note 146: Tech Podcast Recommendations
content: StarTalkRadio is great for deep space topics. CodeNewbie focuses on learning resources. Changelog brings in open source news. Each has its own flavor.

title: Filler Note 147: Remote Work Setup
content: External monitor makes a huge difference. Standing desk helps with posture. Good keyboard and mouse prevent RSI. Lighting matters more than people think.

title: Filler Note 148: Version Control Principles
content: Atomic commits are better than monolithic ones. Good commit messages are your future self's documentation. Rebasing helps before merging. Squashing large feature branches is often wise.
